newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Telecel sees revenue increase in 96.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Telecel sees revenue increase in 96.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel-Telecomunicacoes Pessoais expects to see a sharp rise in its revenues to at least 50 billion escudos this year from 32.5 billion in 1995, its president Antonio Carrapatoso said.
Speaking at a presentation for a new product, he declined to give a profit forecast for 1996. Telecel posted a net profit of 2.5 billion escudos in 1995.
"Telecel will exceed 50 billion escudos of revenues this year and will probably surpass 300,000 clients," Carrapatoso said.
Analysts said they expected the flotation of Telecel to take place in New York as well as Lisbon by mid-December. Carrapatoso declined comment on plans for the flotation.
